LAYOUT & STRUCTURE:
A full-height 2-column split screen:
1. LEFT COLUMN (Navy Branded Panel, ~40-42% width, bg-slate-900 / #0a0f1d deep dark navy with subtle dot grid background and soft ambient radial glow):
   - Top Header row: BICE LMS Data Academy brand mark badge with icon in indigo container, plus 'Back to website' pill button with subtle border and arrow.
   - Status tag: '• Enterprise & Individual Account Recovery' in a subtle rounded pill.
   - Bold Hero Typography: 'Regain access to your career toolkit.' (white, Inter, tight tracking, ~44px bold).
   - Descriptive paragraph: 'Secure, encrypted recovery for your executive analytics curricula, real-world sandboxes, and verified certifications.'
   - Value / Feature Highlights list in subtle dark translucent cards with soft borders:
     * Card 1: 'Instant Verification' - 'Time-limited, one-click magic links with SHA-256 encryption.'
     * Card 2: 'Continuous Progress' - 'Your workbook submissions, capstone code repos, and streak counters stay strictly intact.'
     * Card 3: 'Enterprise SSO Guard' - 'Seamless single sign-on re-authentication for corporate enterprise cohort learners.'
   - Bottom testimonial card (dark translucent card with gold 5-star rating, verified quote):
     "The support and recovery system is rock-solid. Got back into my Power Query capstone within minutes without missing cohort submission deadlines."
     Author: Samantha Patel, Lead Financial Analyst, Deloitte (avatar badge 'SP' with verified checkmark).

2. RIGHT COLUMN (~58-60% width, bg-slate-50 / #F8FAFC with crisp white elevated card):
   - Top utility link: 'Need help? Support desk' on top right.
   - Main Elevated Card (rounded-2xl, border border-slate-200/80, bg-white, shadow-xl p-8 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full):
     * Key/Lock Icon badge in soft indigo rounded square (w-12 h-12, bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600).
     * Card Title: 'Reset your password' (Inter, 28px, font-bold, text-slate-900).
     * Subtitle: 'Enter the email associated with your account and we will send you a secure reset link.' (text-slate-500, text-sm, leading-relaxed).
     * Form:
       - Email input group: Label 'Work or Personal Email address', input field with mail icon prefix, active placeholder 'rahul.sharma@gmail.com' or 'samantha.patel@deloitte.com', crisp focus ring.
       - Full-width CTA button: 'Send reset link' (primary indigo-600 with white text, font-medium, rounded-lg, flex items-center justify-center gap-2 with right arrow icon, hover:bg-indigo-700 transition).
       - Back to login link: Centered flex row with left arrow and 'Back to login' link (text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-600).
     
     * Inline / Below Success State Banner (as explicitly requested):
       - Elegant prominent success feedback box (bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl p-4 mt-6):
         - Top row: Lucide green check circle icon (w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0) alongside headline: 'Reset link sent!' (font-semibold text-emerald-900 text-sm).
         - Body: 'Check your inbox at r***@gmail.com. We sent instructions to reset your password. Link expires in 30 minutes.' (text-emerald-700 text-xs mt-1 leading-normal).
       - Troubleshooting & Resend Actions:
         - A subtle helper row below the banner:
           * "Didn't receive it? Resend" (link in font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline cursor-pointer)
           * Divider dot "•"
           * "Contact support" (link in font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-600)
           * "Check spam folder" hint

   - Card Footer / Legal Security:
     * 'Secured with Firebase Authentication • 256-bit TLS encryption' with small padlock icon.
     * © 2025 BICE Data Academy • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service.
